sloka: रामः तु सह सौमित्रिः सुतीक्ष्णेन अभिपूजितः ।परिणाम्य निशाम् तत्र प्रभाते प्रत्यबुध्यत ॥३-८-१॥
transliteration: rāmaḥ tu saha saumitriḥ sutīkṣṇena abhipūjitaḥ ।pariṇāmya niśām tatra prabhāte pratyabudhyata ॥3-8-1॥

translations.english: Rama, worshipped by Sutikshna and accompanied by Lakshmana, spent the night at the hermitage, and got up early in the morning.
